description: Enable a disabled Monitor so its Cycles run on its schedule. Enabling starts a Cycle at once, and the result's startedCycleId names it; startedCycleId is absent when no Cycle started, because the Monitor was already enabled, recent Cycles reached the limit on immediate Cycles, or the start failed. An enabled Monitor runs Cycles unattended until disable_monitor stops it. Its Cycles burn Fuel unless the account has a plan that includes monitoring, which covers them up to its limits; get_documentation topic 'faqs/plan-or-fuel' explains how. Enable only after the user confirms in this conversation. Idempotent: on an enabled Monitor it changes nothing, starts no Cycle, and returns the current state. An unclaimed Trial is refused until the user creates an account.
name: enable_monitor
title: Enable Monitor
